description: This file defines a configuration class `NvidiaNimConfig` for interfacing with Nvidia's NIM API, extending from an existing OpenAI chat configuration class. It provides methods to retrieve supported parameters for different models and to map OpenAI parameters to the Nvidia NIM specific API.

classes.name: NvidiaNimConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Nvidia NIM's Chat Completions API, providing supported parameters and mapping logic based on model types.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported for a given Nvidia NIM model.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps a set of OpenAI parameters into a compatible set for Nvidia NIM models, considering supported parameters for specific models.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
